expected_text_segments:
Update: Tanker strikes, US strikes on Iran and a softer word from Trump: what markets carry into Monday and a CPI week

Hormuz attacks meet active diplomacy before the CPI week; Nvidia adds to AI-stock stress.

What to watch: A 0.3% or higher reading would likely seal a December hike, lift the dollar and weigh on gold and stocks; 0.1% or lower would do the opposite.

Read the full brief: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/tanker-strikes-us-strikes-on-iran

Capital Chronicle's dated review provides analysis, not independently confirmed event facts or a performance record.

Base case: 55% Capital Chronicle model estimate. Talks continue; oil firms at the open, then fades.
Alternative: 25% Capital Chronicle model estimate. Hormuz escalation lifts oil and weighs on stocks.

Analysis, not financial advice.

Capital Chronicle may hold positions in the markets it covers.

Chart: TradingView.
